alpha_source: uncalibrated default (leads.hybrid.DEFAULT_ALPHA). The form-rubric calibration is in artifacts/alpha_calibration.json; it does not transfer to the live chat rule score, which is computed over a different feature subset.
model_description: rf_full: RandomForest trained on 861 real counsellor rows + 1000 v1 synthetic sessions. About 71% of its importance sits on synthetic-only engagement features, so the live score is an engagement-persona score, not a validated lead-conversion model. Provisional demo output.
